dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 31, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Yankees Shut Down Cubs Behind Warren's Dominant Performance**

Will Warren tossed 6.2 scoreless innings, striking out seven without walking a batter, to lead the New York Yankees to a 2-0 shutout of the Chicago Cubs. Spencer Jones hit his fourth home run of the season, a solo shot to right center field, to provide the game's only offense. Jones finished the night 1-for-2 with an RBI.

**Reds Edge Pirates in Thrilling 8-7 Comeback**

The Cincinnati Reds overcame a 7-4 deficit in the ninth inning, scoring three runs on a series of errors and a two-run homer from Sal Stewart, to defeat the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7. Stewart finished the night 2-for-5 with four RBIs, including a game-tying two-run homer in the ninth.

**Orioles Come From Behind to Beat Phillies**

The Baltimore Orioles trailed 4-2 heading into the eighth inning, but scored four runs in the frame to take the lead and ultimately defeat the Philadelphia Phillies 6-4. Pete Alonso hit his 10th home run of the season for the Phillies, but it wasn't enough to lift his team to victory.

**Blue Jays Shut Down Cardinals**

Dylan Cease pitched six strong innings, striking out seven without walking a batter, to lead the Toronto Blue Jays to a 3-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals. Luis Urías drove in two runs with a single in the first inning to give the Blue Jays an early lead.

**Diamondbacks Blank Guardians**

Jonathan Loáisiga earned the win in relief, pitching a scoreless inning to help the Arizona Diamondbacks defeat the Cleveland Guardians 4-1. Geraldo Perdomo and Ryan Waldschmidt each had two hits for the Diamondbacks, who took advantage of a strong starting pitching performance to secure the victory.

**White Sox Rout Rays**

Erick Fedde pitched five strong innings, striking out six without walking a batter, to lead the Chicago White Sox to a 6-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays. Munetaka Murakami homered and drove in two runs for the White Sox, who took advantage of a strong pitching performance to secure the win.

**Marlins Edge Mets**

Janson Junk pitched five scoreless innings, striking out four without walking a batter, to lead the Miami Marlins to a 5-2 victory over the New York Mets. Francisco Lindor homered for the Mets, but it wasn't enough to lift his team to victory.

**Braves Rout Nationals**

Michael Harris II hit a three-run homer and drove in three runs to lead the Atlanta Braves to a 6-2 victory over the Washington Nationals. Bryce Elder earned the win, pitching two scoreless innings in relief.

**Astros Blast Rangers**

Hunter Brown pitched 5.2 scoreless innings, striking out five without walking a batter, to lead the Houston Astros to an 11-2 victory over the Texas Rangers. Yainer Diaz homered and drove in one run for the Astros, who took advantage of a strong pitching performance to secure the win.

**Rockies Shut Down Royals**

Michael Wacha pitched six strong innings, striking out seven without walking a batter, to lead the Colorado Rockies to a 3-1 victory over the Kansas City Royals. Carter Jensen homered for the Royals, but it wasn't enough to lift his team to victory.

**Brewers Beat Angels**

Shane Drohan pitched six scoreless innings, striking out seven without walking a batter, to lead the Milwaukee Brewers to a 6-2 victory over the Los Angeles Angels. Jake Bauers homered and drove in three runs for the Brewers, who took advantage of a strong pitching performance to secure the win.

**Tigers Crush Athletics**

Dillon Dingler homered and drove in four runs to lead the Detroit Tigers to a 13-1 victory over the Oakland Athletics. Ty Madden earned the win, pitching two scoreless innings in relief.

**Padres Shut Down Giants**

Yuki Matsui pitched three scoreless innings, striking out two without walking a batter, to lead the San Diego Padres to a 7-0 victory over the San Francisco Giants. Jase Bowen homered for the Padres, but it wasn't enough to lift his team to victory.

**Red Sox Rout Dodgers**

Ceddanne Rafaela homered and drove in two runs to lead the Boston Red Sox to a 9-4 victory over the Los Angeles Dodgers. Brayan Bello earned the win, pitching four scoreless innings in relief.

**Twins Edge Mariners**

Zebby Matthews pitched five strong innings, striking out ten without walking a batter, to lead the Minnesota Twins to a 5-3 victory over the Seattle Mariners. Brooks Lee homered and drove in two runs for the Twins, who took advantage of a strong pitching performance to secure the win.
